summary: Criminal appeals against dismissal of revisions challenging two FIRs; allegations of forgery, fraud, cheating under IPC and IT Act; contention that second FIR invalid due to absence of affidavit in complaint under Cr.P.C. s.156(3); precedent in Priyanka Srivastava (2015) requiring affidavits treated as prospective only; court affirmed retrospective vs. prospective application principles; appeals dismissed; appellants may seek discharge if charges not framed.
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; High Court judgment upheld; appellants may apply for discharge if charges not framed.
